Dear Darling,

As I gaze upon you now, I hope you understand that you mean the world to me. My reason for being, my one true wish, my drive for being better every single day beings with you. I wake up every morning wishing I could give you the life you want and I work hard to ensure that happens.

The past 3 years have been nothing short of amazing. I have never met someone so support, amazing, and beautiful to boot. You are the best thing to ever happen to me and I want you to never forget that.

Do you remember the first time we were at the mountain, and you were so cold that you had a mountain of blankets on top of you? Every time I think about that moment, I think, “Why is she up here, why be in the bitter cold?” Later did I realize you did it for me. I learned that you do so much for me that I did not realize and I have yet to realize. You do so much, and I want you to understand that I will try my best to notice. I may not notice every time, but I hope you give me enough time and patience to realize it one day.

Of all the guys in the world you chose me, and I thank god every day that I get to wake up next to the best women in the whole wide world. I tend to think about our future a lot, where we will be, if we will stay where we are, or even if we will have children and when we will get married. When I think of those things, I get a little sad, because I worry that our life will be too busy. Too busy taking care of the kids or the house or other people. However, I learned to realized that will never happen. I will make it a point to ensure that you are my number one priority, “F dem kids” as the tic tok goers say.

As you sit here reading this letter, I hope I can make you as happy as you make me every single day. I may not be as amazing, beautiful or hard working as you, but I will do my damnedest to ensure that I am in competition with you.

Always and forever,
Honey
